title: Release acceptance gatekeeper harness for rollout safety and LTS promotion
creator: Ava Thompson
description: Implement a release acceptance harness (Gatekeeper) that runs a composable set of pre-promotion checks for every build candidate. Goal: provide deterministic pass/fail signals combining smoke probes, workload-shaped perf regressions, semantic eval suites, and KV-cache warmup verification before allowing automatic rollouts or LTS promotion. The harness will run as a CI stage and as a periodic preflight job in the release pipeline and will integrate with the rollout controller to block or mark builds for manual review. This ticket covers the spec, CI plumbing, dashboard and alert definitions, and the automated decision engine for hold/rollback recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: A CI job ci/release/gatekeeper/<build> executes the full harness within 60 minutes on dedicated test pool
Gate returns a deterministic pass/fail and a JSON artifact with signals (latency deltas, cost delta, quality score) stored in S3/Artifacts service
Thresholds configurable per channel (canary, stable, lts) and visible in the Console rollout UI
Integration with rollout controller: passing builds can auto-promote to 'staged' while failed builds trigger automatic pin and rollback recommendation
Alerting rules created for false positives (ops paging) and for sustained gate flaps
tasks: Draft spec for composite gate scoring and weightings for perf/quality/cost
Implement harness runner that composes smoke, perf, semantic eval and cache-warm probes
Add CI job and self-hosted executor config in CI fleet
Publish gate artifact schema and add parser in rollout controller
Create dashboards and SLOs for gate performance and false-positive rate
Run 3 full candidate rehearsals and iterate thresholds
